summary: iter180 verified the Stripe Reconciliation hotfix (Zoe Ward incident). All 6 admin endpoints work, webhook is resilient to malformed/orphan events, sample-checkout uses _resolve_webhook_url, credential_check enforces SITE_URL/BACKEND_URL, and the /admin/stripe-reconcile page renders with all required data-testids (50 orphans shown, recover/fulfill/refund per row, scan-btn, search-input). 23/24 tests pass — 1 minor API contract mismatch on recover-one for unknown sessions (returns {error: 'order_not_found'} instead of {recovered: false, reason: 'order_not_found'}).

minor.issue: When session_id does not exist in DB, returns {"error": "order_not_found", "session_id": ...} but the review spec requires {"recovered": false, "reason": "order_not_found"}. Logic is correct (it detects missing order) but contract differs from spec — the frontend StripeReconcile.jsx may need to handle either shape. Source: /app/backend/routes/stripe_reconcile.py:120.

action_items: OPTIONAL (low priority): In /app/backend/routes/stripe_reconcile.py:120, change `return {"error": "order_not_found", ...}` to also include `recovered: False, reason: "order_not_found"` so the JSON contract matches the review spec and is consistent with the other branches that DO return `recovered: False`.
critical_code_review_comments: shop.py is 6609 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Continue migrating to modular routers (e.g., shop_checkout.py, shop_samples.py). Not blocking the current hotfix.
_resolve_webhook_url contract is solid: SITE_URL > BACKEND_URL > request.base_url, with HTTPException 500 when all three are missing. All 5 call sites in shop.py updated correctly.

Webhook handler (server.py:8464-8540) correctly handles 3 paths: sample_order via metadata.order_type, shop_order via payment_transactions, and shop_order fallback via stripe_session_id stamped on the order. Returns {status: ok} on safely-malformed events — verified resilient (no 500s when fake session sent).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (page renders, all required data-testids present, 50 orphan rows visible with recover/fulfill/refund buttons each, scan-btn clickable)

seed_data_creation: None. 50 orphans already existed in dev DB. £8268.50 total at-risk value.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe Reconciliation hotfix is functionally complete and production-ready. The only finding is a minor JSON contract mismatch on recover-one's order_not_found branch — does NOT block deploy. All 12 unit tests in test_stripe_reconcile_unit.py pass. All 6 admin endpoints require auth (verified 403 anon). Webhook returns non-500 for orphan/malformed events as designed. _resolve_webhook_url has correct priority (SITE_URL > BACKEND_URL > req.base_url). credential_check correctly accepts EITHER SITE_URL or BACKEND_URL. Frontend page renders 50 orphans with all required testids (stripe-reconcile-page, orphan-count=50, scan-btn, search-input, recover-{id}, fulfill-{id}, refund-{id}, orphan-row-{id}).

verified_features.2_scan_endpoint: PASS — 403 anon, 200 admin dry_run=true returns {scanned, recovered, still_pending, errors}

verified_features.7_webhook_shop_order_fallback: PASS — fake session with no payment_transactions row does NOT 500
verified_features.8_credential_check_site_or_backend_url: PASS — code at /app/backend/services/credential_check.py:86-90 accepts either env var; backend booted cleanly with only BACKEND_URL set
verified_features.10_frontend_stripe_reconcile_page: PASS — page renders, all 4 page-level testids present, 50 orphan rows each with recover/fulfill/refund testids, scan-btn clickable, search-input visible, heading 'Stripe Reconciliation' rendered, sidebar nav working

rca_of_the_issue: Original 2 May 2026 Zoe Ward incident: customer paid £2.99 for a sample but order stayed pending because (a) sample checkout passed empty webhook_url so Stripe never POSTed to /api/webhook/stripe, (b) shop_orders Klarna/PayPal Express paths skipped payment_transactions row creation so the webhook had no DB row to flip, (c) request.base_url is unreliable behind Railway's proxy. Fix verified: _resolve_webhook_url prioritises SITE_URL > BACKEND_URL > req; webhook handler now branches on metadata.order_type=sample AND falls back to stripe_session_id on shop_orders when payment_transactions row is missing; admin reconcile tool gives ops a one-click recovery path for any historical orphans (50 currently surfaced in dev). End-to-end confirmed at API + UI layers.
